Мод проверит, какие его функции реально:
The mod will check which of its features really speed up the game on your device.

A temporary world opens with a test scene: mobs, items, chests, holograms. The scene grows until FPS drops to a working level; the mod will not push your device hard. Then features are switched on and off one by one while FPS is measured, and you pick the LOD range and item style by eye. It takes 3–4 minutes; progress is shown in the panel on the left.

During the test do not touch the mouse or keyboard and do not minimise the game. Close the browser and screen recording: they distort the measurements. Cancel — Esc.

Your worlds will not change and the temporary world deletes itself. Settings change only if you apply the result.
